paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Bisna. R. Abba said to him, Avodah Zarah (33b). He addressed R. Ammi as 'my teacher,' Zevaḥim (20a). He spoke to Rav Bivi, Shekalim, chapter 3, halakhah 2, and the last chapter, halakhah 1; Menaḥot (103b). He asked R. Pedat, Yevamot (113, end of side b). When Rav died, he decreed that no myrtle and palm branches be brought to a wedding house that year. Bar Kasha of Pumbedita transgressed; a snake bit him, and he had no cure, chapter Shemonah Sheratzim (110a). In Shemuel's name, Shekalim, last chapter, halakhah 4. He said, 'R. Shimon ben Yoḥai said,' Niddah, chapter 7 (56a).
